g.text: Rapidly inject selenium precursor with TOP and DPP
25 mL round-bottom flask; neck count and heating hardware unspecified
Inputs: Clear cadmium precursor solution; Trioctylphosphine; Diphenylphosphine; Nominal TOPSe
Rapid injection is stated without a numerical rate. Main p.11 reports 0.15 mmol Se in 100 mL
TOP and calls this 1.5 M TOPSe. The stated amount/volume implies 0.0015 M, a factor-1000
conflict. Both source values remain; later nominal 1.5 M doses are not silently corrected.
Source 25 mL round-bottom flask; neck count, heating apparatus and fill level unspecified.
Source: Main PDF p.12 Core Synthesis; small cores
